target: QualityBlock1990s native 3840x2160 benchmark and real-time Unity playback
purpose: Prevent textured generated benchmark surfaces from entering the native 4K review path with obviously inadequate source texel density. This is a source/readiness floor only: it does not prove perceived detail, absence of blur, or absence of shimmer without sealed native render evidence.

measurement.metric: area-weighted physical texels per metre per textured renderer submesh
measurement.formula: sqrt((world-independent UV triangle area * abs(_MainTex_ST.x * _MainTex_ST.y) * textureWidth * textureHeight) / world triangle area)
measurement.worldAreaSource: renderer localToWorldMatrix applied to triangle positions
measurement.submeshMaterialBinding: mesh submesh index matched to renderer sharedMaterials index
measurement.degenerateTrianglePolicy: ignore zero-world-area triangles; fail a textured submesh when no non-degenerate UV area remains
measurement.nonReadableMeshPolicy: fail closed for managed textured benchmark geometry because the physical-density proof cannot be computed

thresholds.rationale: The 256 texel/m floor is a conservative source-asset adequacy baseline for native 4K framing; hero surfaces should normally exceed 512 texel/m. The floor is intentionally not a Visual Fidelity score and does not replace 100% crop inspection.

interpretationLimits: A passing source density cannot prove a texture is sharp, physically authored, non-repetitive, or visually plausible.
A high texel density can still shimmer when frequency content, alpha coverage, filtering, LOD transitions, or thin geometry are unstable.
Procedural or geometry-only materials without _MainTex are outside this calculation and remain covered by their material/geometry contracts.
The native hero, oblique and grazing captures plus temporal sequences remain authoritative for perceived texel fidelity and aliasing deductions.

inspection: obvious texture/module repetition despite adequate raw density
normal/roughness detail resolving at a visibly different physical scale from albedo
grazing sparkle, moire or crawl caused by excessive unresolved high-frequency detail

lookdevGenerationBrief.deliverable: 4K-neutral material calibration sheet showing painted RC, aged aluminum, galvanized steel, PVC-U, asphalt/ground aggregate, curtain textile and foliage at orthographic, 45-degree oblique and grazing-light angles
requirements: include a metric 10 cm / 50 cm / 1 m scale reference beside every surface
show flat diffuse illumination and midsummer directional grazing illumination as separate panels
no baked highlights, vignette, depth of field, sharpening or beauty grading
include native 100% crops so microstructure scale can be judged independently of composition
